about: Every file of every client package shipped before update.py existed (2026.09.03 to 2026.09.25.2): `blobs` holds each path's git blob ids, `versions` maps a VERSION to the one it shipped with (an index into that path's list, -1 = absent; paths in sorted order). From the six shipped zips on hand plus package-for-client.sh re-run at the release commits (and 13 commits between them, blobs only). `standins` maps an old blob that carried a name the package no longer ships to its scrubbed twin in the history pack. update.py reads it the first time a pre-update install is updated, to tell a file its owner changed from one they did not. Frozen: each build adds its own files to the copy it ships.
